name: eth_call
description:
If the execution reverts, or ends with an exception such as a failing native contract call or running out of gas, the method returns error -32015 instead of a result. A revert reports `VM Exception while processing transaction: revert <reason>` or `VM Exception while processing transaction: transaction reverted`. An exception reports `VM Exception while processing transaction: execution failed`. This holds whether or not RSKIP692 is active. 

 If the transaction fails a check that runs before execution, such as having gas below its intrinsic cost or create init code above the RSKIP438 size limit, the method returns error -32010 with the reason, for example `Not enough gas for transaction execution: tx needs: 21000 tx sent: 20000`. 

 The `gas` value is read as an unsigned integer. If it is omitted, it defaults to 100000000000000. Any value above the `rpc.callGasCap` node setting (10000000 by default) is reduced to that cap. Setting the cap to 0 disables it, in which case a value above 2^63 - 1 is reduced to 2^63 - 1.
summary: Executes a new message call (locally) immediately without creating a transaction on the block chain.

result.name: returnValue
result.description: The return value of the executed contract
